subject: RM_Fuzz
departures: silver-green colouring across the whole mat, not ordinary grass green
fine, feathery frond-like leaves instead of flat grass blades
every frond lies combed in one single direction, as if swept flat by a constant wind
a dense, continuous low mat no taller than knee height, without separate tufts or clumps
no visible crown, stem base or seed heads above ground: the fronds come straight out of the soil
